rationale: One major finding (CR-001): folder-name slug collision can produce duplicate DOM IDs when two folders differ only in special characters, causing screen readers to announce the wrong folder name for the second folder's More Options button. Two of three branch commits also use a non-conforming message format (feat(a11y):...) but squash merge mitigates CI risk — noted in standards_review. No acceptance criteria available (genuine no-spec round); blind and edge-case lenses ran; one deferred finding (self-referencing aria-labelledby fragility — not a correctness bug today). Confidence is low due to no-spec round.

standards_review.notes: 1 of 3 commits follows EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format. Two commits ('feat(a11y): wire accessible name...' and 'feat(a11y): add aria-controls...') use conventional-commits format that does not match the project regex. Squash merge will produce a single conforming commit on main, mitigating CI gate risk, but intermediate commits may fail CI push validation.
No security concerns. ARIA attributes are read-only accessibility metadata; no user input is processed or rendered unsanitized.

findings.problem: The folder slug `folder.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')` maps any run of non-alphanumeric characters to a hyphen, so folder names differing only in special characters produce the same slug (e.g. 'A/B' and 'A-B' both → 'a-b'). This creates duplicate DOM IDs: `folder-name-a-b` and `chat-tree-folder-group-a-b` would both appear twice. When aria-labelledby on the second folder's NavigationMore button references `folder-name-a-b`, browsers resolve to the first matching element, so screen readers announce the first folder's name for the second folder's More Options button.
findings.impact: Screen-reader users hear the wrong folder name when activating the More Options button on any folder whose slug collides with an earlier one. Duplicate IDs also cause axe/Lighthouse accessibility violations.
findings.recommendation: Use the map index instead of a content-derived slug for the folder-name IDs: `const folderSlug = String(index)` (with `index` available as the second `.map()` parameter). This guarantees uniqueness without changing how the slug is consumed by aria-owns or ChatList id, though those would also need to switch to the index-based key to remain collision-free.
